item.title: Baltimore County records fifth fire fatality of the year after Dundalk man dies
item.description: A man is dead after getting injured in a burn barrel fire in Dundalk. This marks the fifth fire fatality in 2026 in Baltimore County.

item.title: Over 4,000 customers without power due to high winds in Maryland
item.description: Over 4,000 customers are without power due to high winds in Maryland. According to the National Weather Service, wind gusts were in the range of 40-60 mph with higher gusts over ridges and waters.
